comments.body: This condition does not handle an explicitly requested vendor mode. If `GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor`, `goflagsSelectsModMode` returns true and no override is added; if the command contains `-mod=vendor`, the appended `GOFLAGS=-mod=mod` is overridden by the command-line flag. Because setup has modified `go.mod` without updating `vendor/modules.txt`, the subsequent build still runs in vendor mode and fails the vendor consistency check. The explicit `-mod=vendor` case should either be rejected with a clear error or have the vendor metadata updated before building.
